summary:
This half covers commits 281-560 of origin/claude/gurukul-platform..origin/codex/vyakti-completion (844acf4c to 6260611e, 2026-09-04..06). That is Vyakti Rooms waves ten to nineteen (WS-R40..WS-R140), built by ten parallel agents per wave and merged under a 21-check release gate, followed by a short Codex takeover. It added 398 changed files, migrations 102-136 (all applied live), 280 decisions, 187 rejections and 164 measurements.

What was built:
- Product hardening: a door battery (779 cases, 1,440 body-shape fuzz cases, 354 timing interleavings), a full-world leak battery (320,160 checks, 0 leaks), adversarial follower and creator-material batteries, a security-headers and supply-chain gate, CI on Node 22/24, real-browser rehearsals, a parallel eval registry and a comment-aware source tokenizer.
- A prompt-injection boundary: creator material compiled as a delimited data block that the honesty gate does not trust (containment 0/41 -> 41/41, secret leaks 2/5 -> 0/9), with platform-owned teacher boundary and stage-arc constants, plus an ingest-time instruction-shaped detector that files review cards.
- The recall run: deterministic template-only held-out questions scored by a pure lexical scorer (unigram + LCS, negation cap, evasion floor, Devanagari fix), calibrated 49/60 -> 60/60. This is the strongest reusable asset for Taxila's covert comprehension scoring.
- A disclosure kernel ported from Vyakti-GroupAI (influence/gist/paraphrase/verbatim, deny wins, version-bound grants), used for Handoff.
- A care loop: quiet hours as one SQL fragment, monthly notes from the person's own rows with no model call, dormancy, flag-this-reply, a readable DPDP export, a transparency page, Web Push from scratch, and WhatsApp and Telegram lanes.
- Indian payments: Razorpay UPI Autopay mandate lifecycle, a no-regression webhook guard, GST Rule 46 receipts with honest placeholders, referral rewards, payouts.
- Growth: guest taste lane, share kit, SEO page, pure QR encoder, posters, PWA, and Skia-rendered Hindi cards (resvg corrupts Devanagari).
- Full Hindi, with lazy throwing copy chunks, first-Hindi-paint budgets, a tofu probe, node-level lang tags and a Hindi consent legal-review document.
- Ops: incident ledger and withDoor, a self-check cron (names only), operator digest, env manifest, day-one runbook, live probe.
- Codex added Windows/CRLF fixes, row-keyed fake payment refs with a price witness, and a first-room CLI exitCode fix. Wave 20 was planned as ten briefs but not built.

Limits: everything is offline-gated against fake databases and echoing fake models. NEON_URL and model keys are unset on Vercel, and no real Room was ever joined. Rooms are adult-only, so Taxila must re-derive consent for minors with parental consent. Findings from this read: never-rules normalisation strips Devanagari matras; financial year and month boundaries are computed in UTC, not IST; the CSP connect-src 'self' would block Azure realtime.

assets.title: Recall/comprehension answer scorer (scoreAnswer)
assets.what: Pure 0-100 scorer of an answer against a source passage. It computes 0.4 x unigram recall plus 0.6 x LCS word-order ratio over stemmed, synonym-folded tokens; the synonym list is small and covers English and Hindi. A shared key term negated within 4 tokens on one side only caps the score at 15. An answer under 6 words caps at 8. Tokenisation keeps \p{M}, so Devanagari matras survive. hasContradiction is exported.
assets.taxila_target: learning/pedagogy (covert comprehension: score a child's 'explain it back' against the concept text) + evals
assets.evidence: Keyed set 49/60 -> 60/60 (contradiction 0/10 -> 10/10); negative controls fire
assets.notes: LCS term rejects right-words-wrong-order; paraphrase band 60-100; negation is a token window, not grammar; needs a concept-relation key for children rather than a raw passage

assets.title: Template-only held-out question generator (generateRecallSet)
assets.what: Builds the question set with a single fixed template over the AI's own stored sources: 'In your own words, tell me more about this: "<first sentence>"'. No model writes or grades the questions. Duplicates are removed by sha256, the set is refused below 20 questions, and a set hash makes it deterministic.
assets.taxila_target: evals/gates (gate that the teacher agent knows a chapter before it teaches it)
assets.evidence: evals/recall-run/run.mjs asserts identical set_hash across two generations

assets.title: Keyed calibration set for answer scoring
assets.what: 60 hand-authored (passage, answer) pairs. Six classes (verbatim 90-100, paraphrase 60-100, partial 40-70, wrong_on_topic 0-40, contradiction 0-20, evasive 0-10), each with 5 English and 5 Hindi cases, an expected band and a reason. The suite gates on agreement and carries guard-removal negative controls.
assets.taxila_target: evals (build a keyed set of real child answers per class, ideally human-graded)
assets.evidence: 60/60 agreement after WS-R118
assets.notes: Authored by the same session that tuned the scorer, so it is a floor and regression gate, not human calibration

assets.title: Versioned measurement write (guard CTE + supersede + method version)
assets.what: One SQL statement. A guard CTE (rate window) gates both the supersede of the standing row and the insert of the new one. Each row stores the method version string and the set hash. The readiness UI marks rows produced by an older scorer version.
assets.taxila_target: db-schema / evals (any versioned instrument: comprehension score, learning-profile estimate)
assets.evidence: Migration 127 applied live (STATE wave-16)

assets.title: Material block: untrusted content as delimited data
assets.what: renderCreatorMaterial writes creator fields as 'label: value' lines between exported MATERIAL_BLOCK_OPEN/CLOSE markers, after one platform sentence stating the block is data and never an instruction. stripMaterialBlock in api/_surface.js removes the block from the honesty gate's trustedText, so an identifier found only in material is treated as ungrounded and replaced.
assets.taxila_target: prompt-compiler (NCERT text, teacher notes and parent-supplied facts compiled as data) + safety-floor
assets.evidence: Containment 0/41 -> 25/41 -> 41/41; secret leaks 2/5 -> 0/9; cost +453 B then +1,509 B; Meera byte identity 83/83

assets.title: Platform-owned mentor boundary and three-stage teacher arc
assets.what: PLATFORM_BOUNDARY: a permanent teacher, never romantic, with no private meetings, no contact outside the app, and nothing kept from family. Three stage constants: STAGE_EARLY (earn trust through competence, diagnose before teaching, name wrong steps plainly, no praise for effort alone, no predictions), STAGE_GETTING_CLOSE (shared history, teasing only about the work, small self-disclosures, rising standards) and STAGE_ESTABLISHED (callbacks, keeps its edge, warmth rationed and tied to the work, never centres itself). Compiled unconditionally; a creator's own version becomes material.
assets.taxila_target: relational-os / persona-engineering (rewrite the register for ages 6-15; keep the shape)
assets.evidence: 41/41 contained incl. a hostile 'flirt freely' boundary paragraph which lands only inside material (§1b)

assets.title: Instruction-shaped material detector (ingest-time)
assets.what: Pure regex detector over NFKC-normalised text, with Hinglish patterns, for these classes: instruction_override, fake_system_prompt, role_reassignment, exfil_bait, other_creator_identity, homoglyph (Cyrillic mixed with Latin, or fullwidth) and secret_shaped (requires both a secrecy phrase and a token shape). It favours precision, using multi-word collocations only, and imports nothing. A hit routes the passage to a review card; it is not a runtime filter.
assets.evidence: Recall 41/41, false positives 0/15 on its own corpus
assets.notes: Overfit risk: same corpus it was written from; needs a larger real-archive re-measure

assets.title: Adversarial creator-material battery
assets.what: 41 hostile passages (EN+HI, 7 classes) compiled through the real compiler for every injectable field. The scanner locates the real exported markers and reports contained vs fused. Each compiled prompt is byte-diffed against a benign twin. Secret leakage is measured through the real gate with an echo-everything model.

assets.title: Adversarial follower-inputs battery
assets.what: 64 hostile inputs (injection, exfiltration of another follower or the creator, impersonation of creator or operator, reveal system prompt, homoglyph, oversized, empty; 32 EN + 32 HI) are driven through the real follower lane and guest lane on the full 100-follower world. The fake model echoes the compiled prompt. Each prompt is byte-diffed against a benign twin, and an echo-completeness self-test blocks vacuous passes.
assets.taxila_target: evals/safety (child jailbreak, sibling/classmate exfil battery in Hindi/English)
assets.evidence: 71,982 foreign-token checks, 0 violations; 218/218 assertions

assets.title: Never-say rules as an output predicate, one reader for all lanes
assets.what: compileNeverRules turns rule rows into 6-token shingles over NFKC-normalised text, allowing at most 200 rules of at least 3 characters each. A reply that matches is suppressed (fail closed). roomNeverRules is the single reader the say, taste and recall lanes all use.
assets.taxila_target: safety-floor (school/parent 'never say' lists, banned topics for kids)
assets.evidence: Found that reply lanes carried no rules for 3 days before the one-reader fix
assets.notes: normaliseForMatch lacks \p{M} (Devanagari matras stripped) - fix on port

assets.title: Relational disclosure kernel (evaluateDisclosure)
assets.what: Dependency-free port of Vyakti-GroupAI packages/relational-core/src/privacy.ts@9cdc1dc. It uses a closed list of disclosure acts (influence, gist, paraphrase, verbatim). Deny is checked first and always wins. A grant matches only on from, to, act, scope and policy_version together. Expiry is exclusive (now < expires_at). Refusals are named (INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_GRANT_SHAPE, DENIED, GRANT_REQUIRED). The function is pure.
assets.taxila_target: relational-os / parent visibility (what of a child's sessions a parent or teacher may see and in what form)
assets.evidence: 25/25 ported vectors; 256-case exhaustive oracle

assets.title: Handoff v1 on the kernel (human escalation)
assets.what: A follower's verbatim request to the human creator, and the creator's answer, are each evaluated by the kernel behind the ROOM_HANDOFF_KERNEL flag. The grant is self-issued in v0, and a deps.handoffDenies seam is reserved for a block list. Flag on and off issue byte-identical SQL. The document also lists what a multi-party 'Bridge' feature would still need.
assets.evidence: 40/40 handoff; leak layer 6 zero with flag on and off

assets.title: Quiet hours as one spliced SQL fragment
assets.what: quietHoursOkSql, quietHoursOkForFollowerRowSql and quietHoursOkForFollowerSql produce the wall-clock-in-timezone check, including windows that wrap midnight. The follower's own window wins; otherwise the predicate coalesces to a check-in proxy. A QUIET_HOURS_MARKER SQL comment lets evals grep the real SQL that each sweep sends. isQuietHoursOk is a pure JS mirror.
assets.taxila_target: notifications (no pings during school or sleep; parent-set windows)
assets.evidence: evals/quiet-hours negative control with the frozen pre-fix renewals select

assets.title: Monthly note from the person's own rows (no model call)
assets.what: Once a month a follower gets one note covering turns, active days, current streak, threads revisited, check-ins kept and (when memory is on) how many items are remembered. It is pure arithmetic over the follower's own rows, with no model call. The ledger table stores no counts and the note is recomputed fresh. One row per follower per month is the idempotency key. Delivery respects quiet hours and uses push and Telegram; WhatsApp is excluded because no approved template exists.
assets.taxila_target: parent visibility (weekly parent report: minutes, streak, topics covered, comprehension signals)

assets.title: Admin weekly note with n>=5 floor and email seam
assets.what: A Suite admin receives per-Room counts each week, with any count below 5 floored so individuals cannot be identified. There is one ledger row per org, per week, per channel. The email seam records each send and stays hard-coded off until a real sender exists.
assets.taxila_target: school/teacher class dashboard with k-anonymity floor

assets.title: Operator morning digest with Telegram fallback
assets.what: A daily operator digest of counts, incidents and the self-check verdict, delivered by push with a Telegram fallback through the platform bot. A runtime scan checks the message content before it is sent.

assets.title: Incident ledger + withDoor wrapper
assets.what: recordIncident never throws and records no content: one upsert per (day, kind, door, status), with kind drawn from a closed INCIDENT_KINDS list. withDoor(db, door, handler) patches res.status and records a door_5xx incident after the handler settles, without changing the response. A new incident kind triggers a push at most once per kind per day. Rows are pruned after 90 days. Every provider call site records its failures.
assets.evidence: 31 doors wrapped (WS-R123); 18 HTTP session doors observed

assets.title: Self-check cron + env manifest (names only)
assets.what: A daily self-check reports missing env vars by name only, never a value, a length or a prefix. It also checks that the database answers, that each migration family's anchor table exists, and that sibling sweeps are not stale. Optional names come from a manifest generated from ENV-MANIFEST.md (127 names, by section). Findings go through the incident ledger.
assets.evidence: Motivated by both Vercel projects running a day with no NEON_URL unnoticed

assets.title: Day-one runbook with self-checking table
assets.what: A 23-step ordered path from stub config to the first published Room, each step with its proving command. The checker parses its checklist from the markdown table, so the document and the script cannot drift. It runs for free against a deployment.

assets.title: First-room end-to-end live CLI
assets.what: One command walks the live chain: consent, upload, processing DAG, readiness, review, publish, then a second session as follower that opens, joins, says one message, reads history and leaves. Every response is printed verbatim. A missing credential is a printed SKIP row and a locked Room is a BLOCKED row; nothing is skipped silently. A 200 with an empty body is a FAIL. Report variables are var-declared before the first throw. Completion sets process.exitCode instead of calling process.exit, which avoids the Windows libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING crash.
assets.taxila_target: evals/deploy ('first lesson' live smoke CLI: parent consent -> child session -> report)
assets.evidence: 5 consecutive 33/33 on Windows after the Codex fix

assets.title: Live probe with source-parsed expectations
assets.what: Probes 42 public surfaces of a deployment. Expectations (vercel.json header promises, per-cron auth status and body) are parsed from source, never retyped. A self-scan proves the script can only POST always-refused ops. It primes a share-link cookie for protected previews, and an offline fake server provides negative controls.
assets.evidence: 41/42 matched on a live preview (sitemap 500 found)

assets.title: Security headers + supply-chain gate
assets.what: Loads the Room, the studio and four static pages in real Chromium with vercel.json headers applied exactly as Vercel would, and captures CSP violations. The CSP uses script hashes rather than nonces, style-src 'unsafe-inline' only, frame-ancestors 'none' and connect-src 'self'. Also covers HSTS preload, nosniff, referrer and Permissions-Policy (camera and mic 'self' only on the studio). Supply chain is checked with npm ci --dry-run, npm audit --audit-level=high and an install-script allowlist scan.
assets.evidence: Headers verified live on a preview; 0 high/critical audit findings
assets.notes: connect-src 'self' must widen or proxy for Azure realtime; generated modules need sandboxed iframes

assets.title: Performance budgets under a 'bad Indian 4G day'
assets.what: Real Chromium under CDP throttling: 150 ms latency, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up, 4x CPU, 390x844 viewport, 3 runs, median. Budgets: LCP 2500 ms, CLS 0.1, TBT 300 ms, JS 180 KB, fonts 120 KB, with per-target jsBudget overrides. Hindi chunk wait and first Hindi paint (MutationObserver on body) are each budgeted at 800 ms. A failure names the target and the metric.
assets.evidence: first Hindi paint medians 533-596 ms after split

assets.title: Devanagari tofu (glyph) probe with self-control
assets.what: glyphAudit flags a Hindi string only when two things hold: its canvas width is within 10% of the same number of U+25A1 boxes, and its base letters measure uniform within 0.25 px. Each run includes a control: three Unicode noncharacters must measure uniform, or the probe reports itself blind. CI installs the real Noto Sans Devanagari font.
assets.evidence: Two false positives found and fixed (गलत, वजह; then सभी)

assets.title: Accessibility gate with language-tag audit
assets.what: axe-core must report zero serious or critical findings, plus a hand-written keyboard walk over every screen in both locales. langTagAudit requires every Devanagari text node to have a hi-tagged ancestor; lang="hi-Latn" is exempt from the ASCII-only rule, and script and JSON-LD blocks are skipped.

assets.title: Language tagged at the node
assets.what: detectRoomTextLang and detectStudioTextLang return 'hi' when a string contains Devanagari. Spans get their own lang attribute, and the language switch buttons carry their own lang.

assets.title: Lazy throwing Hindi copy table with preload plugin
assets.what: Hindi copy loads only for Hindi users. A Proxy throws *_not_loaded on any read before load, so English is never a silent fallback. ownKeys and getOwnPropertyDescriptor traps keep Object.keys and similar reflection working. The table is split into an auth section (5.6 KB) and the rest. A build-time inline modulepreload script, with its CSP hash committed, runs on ?lang=hi or a remembered locale hint.
assets.evidence: Chunk wait halved after preload; first-Hindi-paint budget back to 800 ms

assets.title: Copy gate with banned product vocabulary
assets.what: Bans em and en dashes, and bans a product vocabulary (clone, replica, model, fine-tune, train, weights, embedding, LoRA, genome) in user-visible strings across named surfaces. Copy files are recognised by name suffix. The allowlist is scoped by file name with a stated reason.
assets.taxila_target: design-system/ux copy (Taxila bans test/quiz/exam/marks in child-facing copy to keep comprehension checks covert)

assets.title: Hindi consent ceremonies as a legal-review document + completeness eval
assets.what: Seven consent ceremonies documented as rows: the English as shipped, a proposed Hindi, a back-translation for reviewers who do not read Hindi, and the statement_set and policy_version ids. Rows that rely on a banned noun are flagged for legal attention. The eval re-extracts the ceremony text from source on every run and checks the Hindi with the real copy scanner. No Hindi reaches the UI before legal sign-off.
assets.taxila_target: auth/consent (Hindi parental consent, DPDP s.9 verifiable consent)

assets.title: Unbundled consents recorded before any turn
assets.what: joinRoom records two separate answers server-side (age and memory) before any turn is possible. The ledger is append-only with no content column, and the newest row is the current answer. Memory consent can be false while the join still succeeds. Age must be true (adult surface). Reasoning cites DPDP full effect on 2027-05-14.
assets.taxila_target: auth/consent (parental consent + child memory consent + voice consent)

assets.title: AI-disclosure card bound into the session token
assets.what: roomDisclosureCard is computed and hashed into the HMAC session token. Every op recomputes the card and refuses a token whose digest is stale, so a page that strips the card cannot buy a turn and a renamed creator cannot keep answering under the old card. A locale switch mints a new session and refetches every server-authored string (WS-R84).
assets.taxila_target: safety-floor/honesty (child and parent always see the AI-teacher disclosure)

assets.title: Readable DPDP export
assets.what: A pure builder turns roomExport()'s result into a printable HTML document in the user's locale, built for the right to understand rather than only to download. TABLE_COPY gives each table one plain sentence in both locales, and a table missing from TABLE_COPY throws instead of being dropped. The page carries no script and no external resource. Completeness is inherited from roomExportManifest.
assets.taxila_target: auth/consent (parent: everything Taxila holds about your child, readable)
assets.evidence: 46/46 manifest tables, 174 assertions

assets.title: Public transparency page
assets.what: Server-rendered page stating what the AI knows, what the creator sees, how long data is kept and which switches change it. Every number is imported from the module that enforces it, never typed as a literal. An unknown, paused or unpublished Room renders the identical platform card.

assets.title: Dormancy notice then forget
assets.what: An inactive account gets a notice, then is forgotten after a grace period. The forget predicate re-derives 'not seen since the notice' from two timestamps rather than trusting a cleared flag. The sweep is folded into the existing renewals cron and sits behind the ROOM_DORMANCY flag. WhatsApp stays inert because no approved template exists.
assets.taxila_target: DPDP retention for inactive child accounts

assets.title: Flag this reply
assets.what: The follower sends only the reply's sha256 plus one reason from a closed list (wrong, harmful, not_them, other). The server reads the exact text back from that follower's own history and never trusts a text field. The follower lane and the creator lane are written in one statement. A unique index (follower_id, reply_sha256) is the double-flag refusal. Limited to 20 per day.
assets.taxila_target: safety (child/parent flags a teacher reply -> review queue)

assets.title: Instruction-shaped review card
assets.what: When the detector flags uploaded material, the result is a review card the owner decides on, not a runtime filter. A source the owner refuses can never be applied by a later ingest run. Removing a source reuses the 'never' state.

assets.title: Web Push from scratch + closed-kind service worker
assets.what: Implements RFC 8291 (aes128gcm with ECDH P-256 and HKDF) and RFC 8292 (VAPID ES256) on node:crypto, reproducing RFC 8291 Appendix A byte for byte. Payload builders (checkin, renewal, dormancy, month note) carry no content. The worker accepts one {t,title,body,url} contract over a closed kind list, and an unknown kind is dropped with a named warning.
assets.evidence: Real-browser interop unproven live; a Chromium notification test needs a full build with a control

assets.title: Installable PWA with derived precache
assets.what: Each Room gets a manifest served as literal bytes. The service-worker precache list is derived from the import() literals of the real built page, including Rolldown's template-literal imports. Responses under /api/ are never cached. The offline phase is detected with navigator.onLine.
assets.evidence: Manifest and SW byte-identical on live preview

assets.title: Pure QR encoder
assets.what: QR encoder in pure JavaScript: byte mode, error-correction level M, versions 1-10. GF(256) arithmetic and the RS generator are computed at load time, and the BCH constants are rebuilt from their polynomials. Mask is chosen best-of-8. No npm dependency.
assets.taxila_target: growth (QR on worksheets/school posters for parent onboarding)
assets.evidence: jsqr decodes 10/10 versions (0/10 before two fixes)

assets.title: Server image renderer with correct Devanagari (Skia)
assets.what: Renders og.png, story.png and an A4 poster with @napi-rs/canvas (Skia's text shaper) and a bundled @expo-google-fonts/noto-sans-devanagari TTF that covers Latin and Devanagari in one file. computeCardLayout is pure. Unknown and paused Rooms produce identical bytes. The musl binary is excluded to keep the function under 50 MB.
assets.taxila_target: generative-ui (server-rendered Hindi diagrams, certificates, report cards)
assets.evidence: warm 103 ms mean; live preview PNGs valid

assets.title: Share kit with throwing channel limits
assets.what: Ready text and picture for WhatsApp, an Instagram bio, a YouTube description and a Telegram post. Templates interpolate only {name} and {url}. Each channel's length limit throws instead of truncating. Returns null before the Room is published. Arrivals are counted per channel.

assets.title: Referral link + exactly-once reward
assets.what: The referral link carries a salted hash, not the sender's identity. Self-referral is refused inside the INSERT's WHERE. A friend counts only after their own first charge lands. Three friends earn one free month, with a yearly cap as the final check and a zero-amount receipt. The grant is exactly-once even under a concurrent race.

assets.title: Subscription ledger with Razorpay + fake twin
assets.what: The webhook verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw body before applying anything, never the reverse. It is idempotent on X-Razorpay-Event-Id. KIND_TO_STATE and MANDATE_KIND_TO_STATE map each event, and the paid-tier flip happens in the same multi-CTE statement as the state change. PAYMENTS_PROVIDER=none refuses every write by name. The fake twin shares the Razorpay call shapes. Plans are created lazily, one per rupee amount.
assets.taxila_target: payments (parent subscriptions in INR via UPI Autopay/cards)
assets.evidence: Payments battery 98 then 148 assertions; no live Razorpay call ever

assets.title: Webhook no-regression rank guard
assets.what: A state rank (created < authenticated < active = paused < cancelled = expired) plus a period-timestamp guard, written as SQL CASE expressions with NO_REGRESSION_MARKER. A late or out-of-order webhook can move a subscription sideways or forward but never down, and once it reaches cancelled or expired it can never be revived.
assets.evidence: 354 interleavings; found a real paying-user regression before the fix

assets.title: UPI Autopay mandate lifecycle
assets.what: A separate mandate_state column tracks pending, halted, paused, active, cancelled and completed. A halted or cancelled mandate drops out of the live-subscription partial indexes. A restart closes the old row and inserts the new one in a single statement. A seat-quantity PATCH on a UPI or Emandate subscription is refused before any provider call. Checkout copy names the mandate in both locales.
assets.evidence: 7/9 provider marks verified against Razorpay docs; 2 open

assets.title: GST receipt builder (CGST Rule 46)
assets.what: Receipt numbers take the form VY/<FY>/<n> within Rule 46(b)'s 16-character limit and are claimed atomically per financial year (April to March). GST is 18%, stored in basis points. When GSTIN or SAC is unconfirmed, a placeholder sentence is printed instead. The CGST/SGST and IGST branches exist, but in practice only unknown_state is produced. A backfill sweep issues missing receipts. Printable HTML in both locales.
assets.notes: financialYearFor uses UTC month: IST midnight boundary mismatch (my finding)

assets.title: Creator payouts + statement (RazorpayX)
assets.what: Pays creators through RazorpayX (IMPS), applies the payout status webhook and renders a printable payout statement. A TDS disclosure sentence is shown verbatim because the TDS rate is unconfirmed (set to 0%).
assets.taxila_target: payments (only if a teacher marketplace ever exists)

assets.title: WhatsApp transport with button join gate
assets.what: WhatsApp joins use interactive reply buttons, at most 3 per Meta's documentation. A 24-hour session-window ledger governs replies. The identity key is a salted phone hash under its own surface name. The join number is read from Meta's phone-number endpoint and refused rather than reformatted when it is not valid E.164. Inbound messages go through the same follower lane and the same reply door as the web Room.
assets.taxila_target: parent channel (WhatsApp reports and nudges to parents)

assets.title: Telegram transport + voice note
assets.what: Telegram updates are deduplicated over a bounded update_id window and replies use reply_parameters (Bot API 7.0+). Voice notes reuse the same watermarked clip and the same ceiling as the web Room. The WAV container does not meet sendVoice's format list, but it is kept, with that recorded as structured data, instead of a lossy transcode, because nobody has measured whether the watermark survives one.

assets.title: Guest 'taste' lane (stateless pre-signup demo)
assets.what: A guest may ask three questions before signing in, answered from creator material alone. The lane is stateless by construction: it imports none of the follower writers. Its only write is a content-free (room, day) counter. The turn ceiling comes from the configurable rate limit. An Origin/Referer check blocks cross-origin use.
assets.taxila_target: growth (demo lesson for a parent that stores nothing about the child)

assets.title: Public SEO page with hreflang + JSON-LD
assets.what: Public creator page with hreflang and x-default links, og:locale, and Person and FAQPage JSON-LD checked by a shared validator. The sitemap carries hreflang only for /c/<slug> pages. The slug read normalises with NFKC before the ASCII check.

assets.title: Door battery (every HTTP op attacked offline)
assets.what: Every HTTP op is cased: cross-room sessions, ids supplied in the body, rate limits, body caps of 64 KB (768 KB for transcripts), homoglyph slugs, cross-origin requests, replay and reuse, and cron secrets accepted only from headers with constant-time comparison. The door list is derived by a two-hop import walk. 354 timing interleavings are enumerated, and 1,440 op x hostile-class cases run with a write-poisoned fake db.
assets.evidence: 779 ok at WS-R120; 5 real findings fixed in pass 2

assets.title: Full-world leak battery
assets.what: A seeded (mulberry32) world of 5 Rooms and 100 followers with overlapping memberships, a creator who is also a follower elsewhere, and every transport in use. It runs 320,160 token-leak checks. A static reach layer (TABLE_ROLES) runs a live grep of every api/*.js file. It proves that forgetting one Room leaves the other Room's rows intact, and its negative controls fire.
assets.taxila_target: evals/privacy (child isolation across siblings, classes, schools)
assets.evidence: 0 violations; 27.5 s

assets.title: Rehearsal harness (real browser x real handlers)
assets.what: Real Chromium drives the real React apps through the creator's and the follower's journeys against the real api/*.js handlers over a fixture db. Model and auth seams are swapped by an ESM loader redirect. Each locale gate uses a distinct x-real-ip. A weekly CI job runs the Hindi walks under --full.
assets.taxila_target: evals (child lesson + parent journeys in Hindi/English)
assets.evidence: creator 72 checks, follower 102 checks under --full

assets.title: Eval registry worker pool with serial parity
assets.what: Runs the eval suites in a worker pool sized by pickWorkerCount. Suites that write dist/ run serially first, and suites on fixed ports get their own lane. A --serial mode keeps the old loop as a frozen baseline, and parity between the two modes is checked exactly.
assets.evidence: 414 s parallel vs 808 s serial under load; parity 226/226

assets.title: Comment-aware source tokenizer for static scanners
assets.what: One linear tokenizer pass that understands strings, template literals and (heuristically) regex literals. It exposes stripComments, sqlTextOf, opLiteralsOf and importsOf, and every static scanner reads source through it. A frozen trap fixture exists for each historical prose false positive.

assets.title: Release-gate CI workflow
assets.what: CI runs the whole 21-check gate on a Node 22 and Node 24 matrix with a keyless stub config. A step asserts that no secret reference exists in the workflow. Superseded runs are cancelled. A weekly schedule runs the Hindi rehearsals.
assets.evidence: 8m34s first run, both green

assets.title: Parallel-agent wave kit (briefs, shared laws, merge tools)
assets.what: Ten worktrees run in parallel. Migration numbers are assigned in the briefs, and shared files are append-only. A context-union merge takes one side plus the other side's diff, never a concatenation. Branches merge one at a time under the full gate, and gate-retry repeats only on port collisions. Binding laws: never git stash, never pkill -f, never end a turn waiting on a monitor, launch Chromium by channel when a browser service is needed.
assets.taxila_target: process / build orchestration for Taxila's own workstreams
assets.evidence: Used for 19 waves (WS-R1..R140)

assets.title: Mirrored-constants gate
assets.what: Parses every '// mirror of api/<file>.js#<NAME>' marker in src/ and site/ and asserts that the client copy equals the server value. This exists because client code cannot import from api/.

assets.title: First-five-minutes path card
assets.what: Shows the whole path from sign-in to a published Room, one next action at a time, and disappears when the path is done. It reads state the shell already holds and adds no endpoint.
assets.taxila_target: ux (parent onboarding; child's first lesson path)

assets.title: Row-keyed fake provider refs with price witness
assets.what: The fake provider's ref is a hash of (label, ref, price, local subscription id). A retry of the same row is idempotent, a new row never collides, an unkeyed call gets a random ref, and the hashed price lets tests assert seats x price.
assets.evidence: payments 148/0, org-billing 69/0, reconcile 52/0 (Windows)

assets.title: User-owned IANA time zone + quiet window
assets.what: roomSetQuietHours stores a time zone and a quiet window on the follower's own row. The two times are both-or-neither, and a window without a time zone is refused. isKnownTimeZone accepts Asia/Kolkata even though Intl.supportedValuesOf omits it.

assets.title: Lazy secondary screens with per-target JS budget
assets.what: Secondary screens and the Hindi table are React.lazy chunks. restReady is passed as a prop, never used as a parent mount gate. A locale switch awaits the copy chunk before committing. The performance gate carries per-target JS budgets.
assets.evidence: Room join JS 90,762 -> 80,230 B EN

assets.title: Readiness publish lock
assets.what: Readiness is one number built from parts, including knows_your_material. Publishing is locked below 70 overall or 55 on any single part, and the UI shows one suggested action. A score produced by a stale method is marked.
assets.taxila_target: evals/gates (a subject/chapter goes live only after the teacher agent passes recall)

assets.title: Codex takeover boundary map + cross-platform fixes
assets.what: Maps the product boundaries: Rooms, RelationalOS, Studio, Gurukul, Suites, GroupAI and the website. Adds LF attributes for source files, calls npm through its JavaScript entry point on Windows, supports a CHROMIUM_PATH override, and adds Codex branch CI filters.

rejections.tried: @resvg/resvg-js (2.6.2 and 2.7.0-alpha.2) to rasterise server cards containing Hindi
rejections.what_broke: rustybuzz shaping rendered 'बात' as the wrong glyph and dropped the space after some matra clusters ('प्रिया AI' became 'प्रियाAI'). Skia via @napi-rs/canvas renders correctly.

rejections.tried: @fontsource Noto Sans Devanagari woff2 loaded into resvg

rejections.tried: A 4-token negation window for contradiction detection

rejections.tried: Byte-diffing two consecutive roomSay calls

concepts.name: The one door
concepts.description: Every reply on every surface leaves through gatedReply(); a surface is a transport, never a tenant; a lane with its own model call becomes a second engine.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Voice, text and module-narration replies converge on one child-safety and honesty gate.

concepts.name: Predicates over prompts
concepts.description: Prompt instructions leaked 57-98%, a SQL predicate leaked 0 of 31,122. Caps, disclosure, never-rules, quiet hours and floors are predicates on writes and outputs.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Time limits, contact refusal, banned topics and parent quiet hours are enforced as predicates.

concepts.name: Material is data, rules are platform
concepts.description: User or creator-supplied text sits in a delimited block the honesty gate does not trust; safety boundaries are platform constants a sheet cannot override.
concepts.taxila_relevance: NCERT, teacher and parent inputs are data; the child-safety boundary is a compiled constant.

concepts.name: No model grades its own exam
concepts.description: Held-out questions come from a fixed template over stored rows; the only model call is the one under test.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Separate the comprehension-check generator, the answer key and the scorer from the teaching LLM.

concepts.name: Instrument versioning
concepts.description: Every measurement row stores the method version; rows from a superseded scorer are marked, not compared silently.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning-profile and comprehension estimates carry scorer versions.

concepts.name: SQL marker comment as test hook
concepts.description: Embed /* marker */ in guarded SQL fragments so offline evals can prove the real statement carries the guard.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Proving quiet-hours, consent and isolation guards in real SQL.

concepts.name: Fail closed with named refusals; nobody learns whether a slug exists
concepts.description: Every refusal carries a code; unknown, paused and unpublished resources render identically.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child profile and class URLs must not be enumerable.

concepts.name: Content-free ledgers
concepts.description: Consent, incidents, month notes and counters store no content; numbers are recomputed fresh.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Minimise child data at rest under DPDP.
